What do the colours mean?
Calls at a glance
Solid circle: a call you missed.
Solid square: a call you turned down.
Soft circle: a call you took. The bar shows how long you talked.
Dashed circle: taken on another device, like a watch.
Soft square: they left a voicemail.
Outlined circle: a call you made. The bar shows how long you talked.
Dashed circle: you called and nobody picked up.
Crossed square: a call Parley or your phone blocked.
Plain circle: your phone didn\'t say what kind of call it was.
The shapes tell the calls apart too, so colour is never the only clue. Prefer plain icons and text chips? Settings › Recents & history › Recents style › Simple.
Each kind of call has an icon of its own, so colour is never the only clue. Prefer shapes, dots and bars? Settings › Recents & history › Recents style › Rich.

Pick a SIM, kind of call, time or length. Save it to give it a chip of its own.
Saved filter
A filter you saved, shown by the first letter of its name.
A filter you saved, shown by its name.
Count
Several calls in a row with the same number, coloured like the latest.
Dots
One dot per call, oldest first, each coloured like its badge.
Bar
How long you talked. Longer calls have longer bars.
Calls them back in one tap. It goes once you\'ve called back.
Your phone logged it as a video call. Parley answers video calls with voice only.
Private contact
A call with a private contact, kept in Parley\'s encrypted call history.
A line under the call
What screening noticed, like \"Likely spam\" or \"Don\'t call back\". Red means take care.
Arrow pointing in: a call you took, here or on another device.
Arrow pointing out: a call you made, answered or not.
Bent arrow: a call you missed.
Handset down: a call you turned down.
No-entry sign: a call Parley or your phone blocked.
Tape: they left a voicemail.
Plain handset: your phone didn\'t say what kind of call it was.
Coloured edge
The colour of the row\'s latest call, so missed calls stand out down the list.
Bold name
A missed call you haven\'t returned yet. The row stays tinted until you call back.
Number in brackets
How many calls in a row were with the same number.
Name in red
The latest call was missed or turned down.
